newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo bourse hits record high on strong industrials.
newsitem.headline: Oslo bourse hits record high on strong industrials.

text.p: Norwegian shares performed strongly on Wednesday, propelling the Total index to a new all-time high as the market picked up momentum from foreign markets, a fall in interest rates and stronger oil prices, dealers said.
The index hit a record peak at 854.56 points before falling slightly back near the close to end 1.03 percent higher at 854.52 points. Turnover was a healthy 736.48 million crowns.

"The international markets are the main driver, but interest rates are falling which is helping too. There are very few sellers so people are having to pay up if they want to buy," said an Oslo-based broker.
Industry was the best performing sector, the industrial index rising 1.5 percent to 1434.45 points.
Norsk Hydro gained five crowns to 314 crowns, while food-based conglomerate Orkla, which will post eight-month results on Thursday, put on seven crowns in moderate trade to 365 crowns.

Pharmaceuticals company Nycomed continued to gain ground on market speculation of an imminent takeover offer. The A share closed 4.50 crowns up at 87 crowns, while the Bs rose four crowns to 85.50 crowns.
